title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - RoundTripTime
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/RoundTripTime. Contractual round-trip time defined in the SLA. If not specified, then best effort is assumed. Subclass of QoSMetric per the Gaia-X ontology, with no properties of its own beyond those inherited (metric, guaranteed); inherited properties are documented on the QoSMetric model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'RoundTripTime'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
